xp.rendering: Explicit simulated GPU cube readback for guest cursor packing; actual source, cursor scanout and raw pixels are separate GPU replay

scope: D3D8/9 share app cursor validation, image packing, optional strict GPU readback, image-ready/visibility state, signed screen/client positioning, initial Show position, 32x32 hardware OS warps and follow-on Present synchronization. Non32 logical positions follow the pinned Wine software-position policy; native non32 render-target composition is not measured here. Only A8R8G8B8 power-of-two images within the reported adapter extent are accepted; locked images and invalid CPU storage are refused. Images are copied without retaining source COM objects. GPU images retain source device/handle/mip/cube face identity, use the shared mandatory readback path and free all temporary storage on success/failure. Public app visibility is separate from D3D9 GDI fallback state, so repeated Show before properties remains FALSE and the first app image starts hidden. Existing readback mutation extraction now explicitly selects a definition instead of the new forward declaration. Real XP verifies source Release returns zero, previous BOOL, OS-only movement, negative client positions/hotspots, clipping and a cleared GPU cube face/mip image, with simulated source replies during guest execution. Independent GPU replay validates those actual two cube replies (2048 pixels), sixteen final scanout images (65536 pixels) and sixteen raw images (65536 pixels) per backend. The colored alpha-quadrant reference exposed a prior red/blue swap; A8R8G8B8 expansion preserves BGRA, so cursor texture storage is corrected from RGBA8 to BGRA8. Previous host pixels fail while raw buffers pass; corrected backends pass. The full 55-page SwiftShader target and Metal 533-case conformance are rerun on the rebuilt bundle, plus fresh cursor pages on both backends. Physical Windows HCURSOR replacement, D3D8 automatic GDI capture, non32 software cursor composition, complete Reset/native HAL/Wine/game/FPS contracts, private data/pacing/surface identity/additional swapchains, D3D8 wrapping and completed stages 4/5/6 are not claimed.
